successCriteria.description: tests/unit/modules/auth/auth.service.test.ts asserts that login with correct credentials returns a non-empty string token and a profile whose id/employeeNumber/email/role/managerId match the employee, and that the profile does NOT have `passwordHash` or `terminationDate` properties.

tests/unit/modules/auth/auth.service.test.ts asserts that a wrong email and a wrong password BOTH reject with `UnauthorizedError` carrying the identical message `'Invalid email or password'` (indistinguishable, no account enumeration).
tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts asserts GET /leaves role scoping returns exactly 1 visible request for EMPLOYEE, 2 for MANAGER (self + direct report), and 3 for ADMIN (all).

tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts asserts GET /leaves/:id returns a byte-identical 404 `{ code: 'NOT_FOUND' }` for both a not-visible id and a nonexistent id (asserting `invisible.json()` equals `missing.json()`).

A profile-route test asserts GET /employees/me returns the profile without `passwordHash`/`terminationDate`, returns 401 `{ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }` for a missing or invalid-role actor, and 404 `{ code: 'NOT_FOUND' }` when the actor has no profile.

constraints: Test-only phase: no production source files may change. The deliverables are confined to tests under tests/unit/modules/ (leave.routes.test.ts and auth.service.test.ts, plus any profile-route test file).

Any fake IEmployeeService must implement the full five-method interface (createEmployee, getEmployeeById, getEmployeeByEmail, getEmployeesByManagerId, getEmployeeProfileById) with throwing stubs for unused methods — no `as unknown as IEmployeeService` partial-object cast.
The auth success-path test must set process.env.JWT_SECRET before the test and restore the exact prior value afterward (delete when previously unset, never assign the string "undefined").

Route tests must exercise the HTTP boundary via the existing Fastify seam (decorate the service on the instance, decorateRequest('user', undefined), a preHandler hook setting request.user = actor) — not call the service directly.
Tests must not hardcode secrets; the login test hashes a test-only password at low bcrypt cost (e.g. hashSync(..., 4)) and uses a test-only JWT_SECRET.
outOfScope: Sub-phase 7.1 — Implement GET /employees/me route (src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts, src/modules/employee/index.ts, src/app.ts).
Sub-phase 7.2 — Extend scripts/smoke.js with profile/leave/balance stages.
Any production source change (service, route, repository, model, migration, or app wiring) — this sub-phase is test-only.

entityInvariants.invariant: Never exposes passwordHash or terminationDate; the login/profile test fixtures and assertions must verify both properties are absent from any returned profile.
Visibility is role-scoped (EMPLOYEE self, MANAGER self + direct reports one level, ADMIN all) and status-unrestricted; a not-visible request is indistinguishable from a nonexistent one (same 404).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Public (no token required); wrong email and wrong password are indistinguishable — both UnauthorizedError with the identical message.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: UnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password') for both unknown email and failed compare; success returns { token, profile } with no passwordHash.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Role-scoped: EMPLOYEE sees self only, MANAGER sees self + direct reports (one level), ADMIN sees all.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array (possibly empty); no error for an empty result.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Same role-scoped visibility as list; ADMIN sees any request.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: NotFoundError('Leave request not found') for both nonexistent and not-visible ids — byte-identical 404.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Resolves the actor from the verified token; never a client-supplied id.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: NotFoundError on unknown id; returned profile never contains passwordHash/terminationDate.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The auth test's fake must satisfy the full IEmployeeService interface exactly as declared (five methods with matching signatures).
The leave route tests must reuse the existing Fastify seam and role-scoping fixtures/style already established in the existing leave route test file.
The auth test must exercise the real AuthService.login behavior (bcrypt.compare + signToken) and assert the same error message the service throws.
The profile-route test must match the established employee route test seam and assertions (200 profile, 401 no/invalid actor, 404 no profile).
Error assertions must use the canonical error codes/statuses (UNAUTHORIZED 401, NOT_FOUND 404, VALIDATION_ERROR 400) from the shared error module.

integrationPoints.why: The auth unit test exercises the real login flow (bcrypt.compare + signToken) against a fake IEmployeeService.
The leave route tests register the real routes against a fake ILeaveService to exercise the HTTP boundary and role scoping.
The profile-route test registers the real employee routes against a fake IEmployeeService to assert profile shape and auth/404 semantics.
The auth success-path test relies on signToken minting a real token under the test JWT_SECRET.
